instruction: Studio photograph, medium shot. In an indoor studio with a neutral beige fabric backdrop, the woman in the beige sports bra and black shorts (R1) stands on the left in profile, facing left with her arms raised overhead. Behind her on the right, the shirtless man in black pants (R2) stands facing left, extending his arms to hold her raised hands. Soft studio lighting illuminates their forms against the warm neutral background.
elements: R1 has her arms raised overhead as the contact target
R2 extends his arms to hold R1's raised hands
R2 is positioned behind R1 while making hand contact
R1 and R2 face the same direction during the dance-like pose
indoor studio with a neutral beige fabric backdrop
